533:       afterToolCall: this.afterToolCall,
534:       afterToolOutcome: this.afterToolOutcome,
535:       prepareNextTurn:
536:         this.prepareNextTurnWithContext || this.prepareNextTurn
537:           ? async (context) => {
538:               if (this.prepareNextTurnWithContext) {
539:                 return await this.prepareNextTurnWithContext(context, this.signal);
540:               }
541:               return await this.prepareNextTurn?.(this.signal);
542:             }
543:           : undefined,
544:       convertToLlm: this.convertToLlm,
545:       transformContext: this.transformContext,
546:       getApiKey: this.getApiKey,
547:       getSteeringMessages,
548:       getFollowUpMessages: async () => this.followUpQueue.drain(),
549:     };
550:   }
551: 
552:   private async runWithLifecycle(executor: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
553:     if (this.activeRun) {
554:       throw new Error("Agent is already processing.");
555:     }
556: 
557:     const abortController = new AbortController();
558:     let resolvePromise = () => {};
559:     const promise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
560:       resolvePromise = resolve;
561:     });
562:     this.activeRun = { promise, resolve: resolvePromise, abortController };
563: 
564:     this.mutableState.isStreaming = true;
565:     this.mutableState.streamingMessage = undefined;
566:     this.mutableState.errorMessage = undefined;
567: 
568:     try {
569:       await executor(abortController.signal);
570:     } catch (error) {
571:       await this.handleRunFailure(error, abortController.signal.aborted);
572:     } finally {
573:       this.finishRun();
574:     }
575:   }
576: 
577:   private async handleRunFailure(error: unknown, aborted: boolean): Promise<void> {
578:     const failureMessage = createFailureMessage(this.mutableState.model, error, aborted);
579:     await this.processEvents({ type: "message_start", message: failureMessage });
580:     await this.processEvents({ type: "message_end", message: failureMessage });
581:     await this.processEvents({ type: "turn_end", message: failureMessage, toolResults: [] });
582:     const messages: AgentMessage[] = [failureMessage];
583:     if (aborted && !isTurnHandoffAbort(this.signal)) {
584:       await appendInterruptedTurnMessage(messages, (event) => this.processEvents(event));
585:     }
586:     await this.processEvents({ type: "agent_end", messages });
587:   }
588: 
589:   private finishRun(): void {
590:     this.mutableState.isStreaming = false;
591:     this.mutableState.streamingMessage = undefined;
592:     this.mutableState.pendingToolCalls = new Set<string>();
593:     this.activeRun?.resolve();
594:     this.activeRun = undefined;
595:   }
596: 
597:   /**
598:    * Reduce internal state for a loop event, then await listeners.
599:    *
600:    * `agent_end` only means no further loop events will be emitted. The run is
601:    * considered idle later, after all awaited listeners for `agent_end` finish
602:    * and `finishRun()` clears runtime-owned state.
603:    */
604:   private async processEvents(event: AgentEvent): Promise<void> {
605:     switch (event.type) {
606:       case "agent_start":
607:       case "turn_start":
608:       case "tool_execution_update":
609:         break;
610: 
611:       case "message_start":
612:         this.mutableState.streamingMessage = event.message;
613:         break;
614: 
615:       case "message_update":
616:         this.mutableState.streamingMessage = event.message;
617:         break;
618: 
619:       case "message_end":
620:         this.mutableState.streamingMessage = undefined;
621:         this.mutableState.messages.push(event.message);
622:         break;
623: 
624:       case "tool_execution_start": {
625:         const pendingToolCalls = new Set(this.mutableState.pendingToolCalls);
626:         pendingToolCalls.add(event.toolCallId);
627:         this.mutableState.pendingToolCalls = pendingToolCalls;
628:         break;
629:       }
630: 
631:       case "tool_execution_end": {
632:         const pendingToolCalls = new Set(this.mutableState.pendingToolCalls);
633:         pendingToolCalls.delete(event.toolCallId);
634:         this.mutableState.pendingToolCalls = pendingToolCalls;
635:         break;
636:       }
637: 
638:       case "turn_end":
639:         if (event.message.role === "assistant" && event.message.errorMessage) {
640:           this.mutableState.errorMessage = event.message.errorMessage;
641:         }
642:         break;
643: 
644:       case "agent_end":
645:         this.mutableState.streamingMessage = undefined;
646:         break;
647:     }
648: 
649:     const signal = this.activeRun?.abortController.signal;
650:     if (!signal) {
651:       throw new Error("Agent listener invoked outside active run");
652:     }
653:     for (const listener of this.listeners) {
654:       await listener(event, signal);
655:     }
656:   }
657: }

LLM Core (`@ele/llm-core`)\n\nUnified interface for all LLM providers:\n- OpenAI (GPT-4, GPT-3.5)\n- Google Gemini (Pro, Flash)\n- Local LLMs (via Ollama)\n- OpenClaw providers\n- Streaming, tool calling, structured output\n\n### 3. Memory Core (`@ele/memory-core`)\n\nFour-layer memory architecture:\n- **Short-term**: Conversation buffer (last 20 turns)\n- **Long-term**: FAISS vector store for facts/preferences\n- **Episodic**: Action outcomes and lessons learned\n- **Project**: Active project context (files, todos, deadlines)\n\n### 4. Plugin SDK (`@ele/plugin-sdk`)\n\nThree plugin formats:\n- **Python Decorators**: `@skill` classes (native performance)\n- **JSON Manifests**: Language-agnostic, versioned\n- **WASM Modules**: Sandboxed, polyglot, secure\n\n### 5. Executors (Tools)\n\n| Tool | Implementation | Safety |\n|------|----------------|--------|\n| File Operations | `aiofiles` + `pathlib` | Confirm delete/write |\n| App Launch | `subprocess` / `pyautogui` | Whitelist apps |\n| Browser | Playwright (headless) | Confirm navigation |\n| Shell | `asyncio.subprocess` | Confirm dangerous commands |\n| Email | Gmail/Outlook OAuth | Confirm send |\n| Calendar | Google/Outlook API | Confirm create/move |\n\n### 6. Voice Stack\n\n- **STT**: Whisper (online, high quality) / Vosk (offline, fast)\n- **TTS**: Edge-TTS (Jarvis voice) / pyttsx3 (offline) / Coqui (cloning)\n- **Wake Word**: Porcupine \"Hey ELE\" (always listening)\n\n## Data Flow\n\n### 1. User Command Processing\n```\nUser Input → Interface Adapter → WebSocket/HTTP → API Gateway \n  → Auth Check → Rate Limit → ELE Core Agent\n```\n\n### 2. Agent Processing (LangGraph-style)\n```\nInputNode → SanityCheckNode → RAGNode (parallel) \n  → LLMNodes (PARALLEL: 4 LLMs) → MergeNode \n  → ActionNode → ResponseNode\n```\n\n### 3. Response Streaming\n```\nResponseNode → WebSocket stream → Interface \n  → User sees: thinking stream + screenshots + progress + final answer\n```\n\n## Security Model\n\n- **Secrets**: OS Keyring (Windows Credential Manager) + encrypted `.env`\n- **Audit Log**: Append-only SQLite, immutable\n- **Confirmation**: Risky actions (delete, send, pay) require explicit approval\n- **Sandbox**: Electron `contextIsolation: true`, `nodeIntegration: false`\n- **Code Signing**: Self-signed cert for .exe\n\n## Deployment Topology\n\n```\n┌─────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐\n│  Cloudflare     │     │   Oracle Cloud  │     │    Supabase     │\n│  Pages (Web)    │────▶│  Free Tier      │────▶│  (PostgreSQL,   │\n│  Static + Edge  │     │  (FastAPI,      │     │   Auth, Realtime)│\n└─────────────────┘     │   Functions)    │     └─────────────────┘\n                        └─────────────────┘\n                                │\n                        ┌───────┴───────┐\n                        ▼               ▼\n                 ┌──────────┐    ┌──────────┐\n                 │ Telegram │    │  User    │\n                 │ Webhook  │    │  Devices │\n                 └──────────┘    │(Desktop/ │\n                                 │ CLI)     │\n                                 └──────────┘\n```\n\n## Offline Capability\n\n| Component | Online | Offline |\n|-----------|--------|---------|\n| LLM | All 4 LLMs | Local Ollama only |\n| RAG | Hybrid embeddings | Local FAISS + local embeddings |\n| Voice | Whisper + Edge-TTS | Vosk + pyttsx3/Coqui |\n| Executor | Browser, Email, Calendar | File, App, Shell, Local LLM |\n| Memory | Supabase sync | Local SQLite + FAISS |"

\"url\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"required\": true},\n        \"selector\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"description\": \"CSS selector\"},\n        \"format\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"enum\": [\"json\", \"csv\", \"markdown\"], \"default\": \"json\"}\n      }\n    },\n    \"crawl\": {\n      \"description\": \"Crawl multiple pages\",\n      \"params\": {\n        \"start_url\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"required\": true},\n        \"max_pages\": {\"type\": \"integer\", \"default\": 10},\n        \"follow_links\": {\"type\": \"boolean\", \"default\": true}\n      }\n    }\n  },\n  \"ui\": {\n    \"icon\": \"🌐\",\n    \"category\": \"automation\",\n    \"screenshots\": [\"screenshots/1.png\", \"screenshots/2.png\"]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### main.py (Python Example)\n```python\n# Entry point for JSON manifest plugins\nasync def scrape(ctx, url: str, selector: str = None, format: str = \"json\"):\n    \"\"\"Scrape a single URL.\"\"\"\n    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright\n    \n    async with async_playwright() as p:\n        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)\n        page = await browser.new_page()\n        await page.goto(url, wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n        \n        if selector:\n            data = await page.eval_on_selector_all(selector, \"els => els.map(e => e.innerText)\")\n        else:\n            data = await page.content()\n        \n        await browser.close()\n    \n    if format == \"json\":\n        import json\n        return json.dumps(data, indent=2)\n    elif format == \"csv\":\n        import csv, io\n        output = io.StringIO()\n        writer = csv.writer(output)\n        writer.writerows(data)\n        return output.getvalue()\n    else:\n        return str(data)\n\n\nasync def crawl(ctx, start_url: str, max_pages: int = 10, follow_links: bool = True):\n    \"\"\"Crawl multiple pages.\"\"\"\n    # Implementation here\n    return f\"Crawled {max_pages} pages from {start_url}\"\n\n\n# Plugin registry (auto-discovered)\nPLUGIN_EXPORTS = {\n    \"scrape\": scrape,\n    \"crawl\": crawl\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. WASM Format (Advanced)\n\n### Structure\n```\nmy-skill/\n├── skill.wasm          # Compiled WebAssembly module\n├── skill.wit           # WIT interface definition\n├── skill.json          # Manifest (same as JSON format)\n└── README.md\n```\n\n### skill.wit (WIT Interface)\n```wit\npackage ele:skill;\n\n// Host-provided interfaces\ninterface host {\n    // File operations\n    read-file: func(path: string) -> result<string, error>\n    write-file: func(path: string, content: string) -> result<(), error>\n    list-files: func(pattern: string) -> result<list<string>, error>\n    \n    // LLM access\n    llm-complete: func(prompt: string, model: string, temperature: f32) -> result<string, error>\n    \n    // Logging\n    log: func(level: string, message: string) -> ()\n}\n\n// Skill exports\ninterface skill {\n    // Metadata\n    name: func() -> string\n    version: func() -> string\n    description: func() -> string\n    permissions: func() -> list<string>\n    \n    // Execution\n    execute: func(task: string, config: string) -> result<string, error>\n    \n    // Commands (optional)\n    commands: func() -> list<command>\n    \n    record command {\n        name: string\n        description: string\n        params: string  // JSON schema\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### Rust Implementation Example\n```rust\n// Cargo.toml\n[package]\nname = \"my-wasm-skill\"\nversion = \"1.0.0\"\nedition = \"2021\"\n\n[lib]\ncrate-type = [\"cdylib\"]\n\n[dependencies]\nwit-bindgen = { version = \"0.30\", features = [\"guest\"] }\nserde = { version = \"1.0\", features = [\"derive\"] }\nserde_json = \"1.0\"\n\n[profile.release]\nopt-level = \"z\"  // Optimize for size\nlto = true\npanic = \"abort\"\n```\n\n```rust\n// src/lib.rs\nwit_bindgen::generate!({\n    path: \"../skill.wit\",\n    world: \"skill\",\n});\n\nuse crate::exports::ele::skill::skill::{Guest, Command};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\n\nstruct MySkill;\n\nimpl Guest for MySkill {\n    fn name() -> String {\n        \"wasm-processor\".to_string()\n    }\n    \n    fn version() -> String {\n        \"1.0.0\".to_string()\n    }\n    \n    fn description() -> String {\n        \"High-performance WASM skill for data processing\".to_string()\n    }\n    \n    fn permissions() -> Vec<String> {\n        vec![\"file:read\".to_string(), \"file:write\".to_string()]\n    }\n    \n    fn execute(task: String, config: String) -> Result<String, String> {\n        let config: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> = \n            serde_json::from_str(&config).unwrap_or_default();\n        \n        // Process task with config\n        Ok(format!(\"Processed: {} with config: {:?}\", task, config))\n    }\n    \n    fn commands() -> Vec<Command> {\n        vec![\n            Command {\n                name: \"transform\".to_string(),\n                description: \"Transform data format\".to_string(),\n                params: r#\"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"input\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"format\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}\"#.to_string(),\n            }\n        ]\n    }\n}\n\nexport!(MySkill);\n```\n\n### Build\n```bash\n# Install wasm target\nrustup target add wasm32-wasip1\n\n# Build\ncargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip1\n\n# Output: target/wasm32-wasip1/release/my_wasm_skill.wasm\n# Copy to plugin dir as skill.wasm\n```\n\n---\n\n## SDK Reference\n\n### Installation\n```bash\npip install ele-agent-sdk\n```\n\n### Core Classes\n\n#### SkillContext\n```python\nclass SkillContext:\n    session_id: str\n    user_id: str\n    config: Dict[str, Any]\n    tools: ToolClient\n    llm: LLMClient\n    memory: MemoryClient\n    logger: Logger\n```\n\n#### ToolClient\n```python\nclass ToolClient:\n    # File operations\n    async def file.read(path: str) -> str\n    async def file.write(path: str, content: str) -> None\n    async def file.patch(path: str, diff: str) -> None\n    async def file.stat(path: str) -> FileStat\n    async def file.glob(pattern: str) -> List[FileStat]\n    async def file.delete(path: str) -> None\n    \n    # Shell\n    async def shell.run(cmd: str, cwd: str = None, timeout: int = 60) -> ShellResult\n    \n    # Browser (Playwright)\n    async def browser.navigate(url: str) -> None\n    async def browser.click(selector: str) -> None\n    async def browser.type(selector: str, text: str) -> None\n    async def browser.extract(selector: str) -> List[str]\n    async def browser.screenshot() -> bytes\n    async def browser.pdf() -> bytes\n    \n    # System\n    async def system.open_app(name: str) -> None\n    async def system.notify(title: str, message: str) -> None\n```\n\n#### LLMClient\n```python\nclass LLMClient:\n    async def complete(\n        prompt: str,\n        model: str = \"auto\",\n        temperature: float = 0.7,\n        max_tokens: int = 4000,\n        system: str = None,\n        tools: List[Dict] = None\n    ) -> LLMResponse\n    \n    async def stream_complete(...) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]\n    \n    async def embed(texts: List[str], model: str = \"local\") -> List[List[float]]\n```\n\n#### MemoryClient\n```python\nclass MemoryClient:\n    async def short_term.get() -> List[Message]\n    async def short_term.add(message: Message) -> None\n    \n    async def long_term.search(query: str, k: int = 5) -> List[MemoryEntry]\n    async def long_term.store(key: str, value: str, tags: List[str]) -> None\n    \n    async def episodic.record(action: str, result: str, success: bool) -> None\n    async def episodic.recall(pattern: str) -> List[Episode]\n```\n\n---\n\n## CLI Commands\n\n```bash\n# Scaffold new plugin\nele plugin create my-skill --template python|json|wasm\n\n# Validate plugin\nele plugin validate ./my-skill\n\n# Test plugin locally\nele plugin test ./my-skill \"Summarize README.md\"\n\n# Package for marketplace\nele plugin package ./my-skill  # Creates my-skill-1.0.0.ele-plugin\n\n# Install from package\nele plugin install ./my-skill-1.0.0.ele-plugin\n\n# Install from marketplace\nele plugin install web-scraper@2.1.0\n\n# Publish to marketplace (requires auth)\nele plugin publish ./my-skill-1.0.0.ele-plugin\n\n# List installed\nele plugin list\n\n# Update all\nele plugin update --all\n```\n\n---\n\n## Marketplace Publishing\n\n### Requirements\n- Valid `skill.json` with all required fields\n- Passes security scan (no malicious code, minimal permissions)\n- Has README with usage examples\n- Version follows semver\n- Tests included (for Python/JSON formats)\n\n### Review Process\n1. Submit via web dashboard or CLI\n2. Automated security scan (static analysis)\n3. Community review (7 days)\n4. Approved → Published\n5. Updates: Auto-approved for patch versions, review for minor/major\n\n### Revenue Share (Future)\n- Free plugins: 0% platform fee\n- Paid plugins: 15% platform fee\n- Payouts: Monthly via Stripe Connect\n\n---\n\n## Security Best Practices\n\n1. **Minimal Permissions**: Request only what you need\n2. **Input Validation**: Sanitize all user inputs\n3. **No Secrets in Code**: Use `config_schema` with `secret: true`\n4. **Sandbox Awareness**: WASM plugins run in isolated environment\n5. **Error Handling**: Never expose stack traces to users\n6. **Dependencies**: Pin versions, audit regularly\n\n---\n\n## Migration Guide\n\n### From v0 to v1\n- `@skill` decorator replaces `register_skill()`\n- `SkillContext` replaces `ctx` dict\n- Tool access via `ctx.tools.*` instead of global functions\n- Permissions declared in decorator/manifest, not code"
}
